original_goal.name: normalized_quadratic_pressure_identity
original_goal.hypotheses: nu>0; rho!=0 where geometric; a smooth periodic divergence-free with arbitrary mean; only the local inputs stated below
original_goal.statement: Let R(A)hat(0)=0 and R(A)hat(k)=-sum_ij k_i k_j Ahat_ij(k)/|k|^2 for k!=0. Set Q(b,c)=R(b tensor c)-R(b tensor c)(0), Pi(b)=Q(b,b). original_goal.mathematical_derivation: The R symbol has Frobenius operator norm <=1. The Sobolev product estimate and bounded point evaluation prove continuity of Q. Taking divergence of NSE gives Delta p=-div div(v tensor v); the Fourier symbol solves this equation. A periodic harmonic difference has only its zero coefficient, hence is spatially constant. The transport-pressure coefficient i sum_i k_i b_i/(2pi|k|^2), with b_i=2pi i sum_j k_j (v_j v_i)hat, equals the displayed R symbol. The linear torusSobolevPressure is applied to transport coefficients, then normalized; it is not identified directly with Pi.
